label: DR-008
note: Modern .NET SDK auto-enables the latest C# version; omitting LangVersion from a net10.0 csproj is correct and reviewer must NOT flag it as missing.

known_false_positive.title: Missing LangVersion in Project.Domain.csproj
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: Without an explicit LangVersion the C# language version floats with the installed SDK, so upgrading the SDK can silently change compiler behaviour. Pin LangVersion in the project file.
